# dsh-power-type
English | 中文
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-power-type) [](LICENSE)
Power Mode typing effects for the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web composer**: sparks, shockwaves, combo
effects for the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web composer**: sparks, shockwaves, combo, heat and embers.
## Features

- Caret particles, glowing character echoes and editor shake.
- The current text line heats up with

the streak: amber → orange → red, with heat shimmer and rising embers.
- Heat wraps the text only: n

o composer border and no settlement card.
- Combo counts visible glyphs: English adds per key, while

a multi-character IME commit fills in the matching streak and tick density.
- A quiet synthesized t

ick per keystroke; a heavier impact on Enter, with independent mute and volume.
- Chinese and other
IME composition support, plus light/dark theme adaptation.

in the DSH checkout. Use `CHROME_PATH` and `DSH_TEST_PNPM` to specify executable paths when needed.
Set `DSH_PLUGIN_SPEC=github:huangzhilin-hzl/dsh-power-type` to run the DSH integration test against
